speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of B-symptoms, supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, elevated LDH, and the specific CT findings of mediastinal and axillary lymph node masses in a patient with a smoking history is most consistent with this diagnosis.
